decisive_items: inflamed, infiltrating, necrotic lesion over the implant site
A swab of the lesion grew Staphylococcus epidermidis
dual-chamber pacemaker implantation in the left prepectoral area
response.rationale: R1 specifically identifies the pacemaker pocket as the infection site, directly matching the implant-site lesion and device context. R5 is broader (device-related) and less specific. R4 is generic surgical site infection, R3 is microbial, R2 is unsupported resistance.

rejected.why: Less specific than R1; device-related infection is a broader category.
Describes the organism, not the clinical diagnosis.
No evidence of resistance; progression may be due to pocket infection.
Surgical site infection is less precise than pacemaker pocket infection.
